title: Snake waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- snake body: coiled S-curve -->
  <path d="M28 86 Q28 70 42 68 Q58 66 58 52 Q58 38 44 36 Q30 34 30 22" 
        fill="none" stroke="#39d353" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- belly stripe along body -->
  <path d="M28 86 Q28 70 42 68 Q58 66 58 52 Q58 38 44 36 Q30 34 30 22" 
        fill="none" stroke="#b6f36a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="2 6"/>
  <!-- body shading edge -->
  <path d="M28 86 Q28 70 42 68 Q58 66 58 52 Q58 38 44 36 Q30 34 30 22" 
        fill="none" stroke="#1f8f3a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='20' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#39d353'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='20' rx='13' ry='11' fill='none' stroke='#b6f36a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- snout smile -->
  <path d='M20 24 Q31 30 42 24' fill='none' stroke='#1f8f3a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d='M25 27 l-4 5 m4 -5 l4 5' stroke='#ff5d8f' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='17' r='3' fill='#123d1c'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='17' r='3' fill='#123d1c'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='16' r='1' fill='#eafbe0'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='16' r='1' fill='#eafbe0'/>
  <!-- waving arm from upper body -->
  <path d='M34 28 Q48 22 54 10' fill='none' stroke='#39d353' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 28 Q48 22 54 10' fill='none' stroke='#b6f36a' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='2 6'/>
  <!-- waving hand/paw -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='8' r='6' fill='#39d353'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='8' r='6' fill='none' stroke='#b6f36a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- little waving motion lines -->
  <path d='M66 4 q4 -1 6 1 M68 10 q4 0 5 3' fill='none' stroke='#7ef0a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
